verdict: M201 correctly closes the matched registered-only S4/F4 standalone VCS/DC comparison against M200 S4/F2. Independent VCS proves exact conservation under stalls, residuals, compact-window boundaries, reset flush and malformed traffic, and independent DC exactly reproduces the sealed 3 ns reports. F4 loses standalone throughput/area but wins the M186-additive abstract proxy by 1.2718 percent. Both numerators remain cycle-unadmitted because neither RTL has M199's same-cycle fresh-arrival emission. For the performance-first path, implement and screen F4 bypass first; it has zero abstract post-emit backlog and a conservative 539.969024 um2 headroom before losing to the current zero-cost-bypass F2 additive proxy.

independent_dc_replay.hold_assessment: MET in the ideal-clock pre-macro model, but 0.0006 ns is only 0.6 ps and is not a robust physical hold margin

matched_f2_f4_recompute.assessment: F2 is 7.2351 percent better as a standalone abstract-throughput/logic-area module. F4 is 1.2718 percent better only after amortizing either compactor against M186. This arithmetic is exact, but neither speed numerator is currently an RTL-cycle measurement.

fresh_arrival_cycle_audit.m199_model_behavior: segment_service adds each fresh raw group's nonzero arrivals and removes up to F descriptors in the same modeled cycle
fresh_arrival_cycle_audit.m200_m201_rtl_behavior: descriptor_valid is derived only from registered queue_count_q; an accepted raw group entering an empty queue cannot assert descriptor_accept until a later cycle
fresh_arrival_cycle_audit.independent_observable_witness: with an empty queue, four legal nonzero raw lanes and descriptor_ready high, raw_accept was high while descriptor_valid and descriptor_accept were both low
fresh_arrival_cycle_audit.consequence: the M199 S4/F2 and S4/F4 abstract cycle numerators are not cycle-matched to M200 or M201; current additive density values remain conditional algebraic screens

reason: performance is the stated priority and F4 retains the lower abstract cycle count
M199 reports zero post-emit backlog for S4/F4, while S4/F2 must merge carried and fresh candidates with a maximum post-emit backlog of four
the matched DC result shows that doubling descriptor width costs only 10.4819 percent standalone area and no sequential-cell increase
after M186 amortization F4 currently has a small 1.2718 percent proxy lead
recommended_width.fail_closed_gate: First synthesize bypass F4. If its total compactor area is at most 5852.255041 um2 and timing still meets 3 ns, it beats even a zero-extra-cost current F2 in the same M186-additive algebra. If it exceeds that conservative threshold, build matched bypass F2 before freezing width.
required_vcs: a fresh nonzero arrival accepted into an empty queue must be eligible for descriptor acceptance in that same cycle
exact raw-to-descriptor conservation across empty/nonempty queue, carried plus fresh merge, mid-lane compact-window close and partial raw tails
descriptor and raw stability under arbitrary downstream stall, plus reset and sticky fail-closed attacks
an exact no-stall RTL cycle ledger must match the relevant M199 recurrence before reusing its numerator

findings.finding: All sealed M201 input/output manifests verify, all ten sealed SVA covers are nonzero, and no sealed assertion fails.

An independently authored VCS scoreboard covers 3,578 descriptors with stalls, same-cycle registered push/pop, arbitrary compact-window tails, one/two/three-lane residuals, reset flush and four malformed cases with exact conservation.
Independent 3 ns DC exactly reproduces 5,312.286017 um2, 7,065 cells, 873 sequential cells, 32 levels, 0.6761 ns setup slack and 0.0006 ns hold slack.

M201 and M200 both lack M199's fresh-arrival same-cycle emission. The independent first-arrival witness observes the bubble directly, so neither 1.272243182967x nor 1.241353012352x may be called an RTL-cycle speedup.
Advance bypass-capable F4 first and require exact no-stall cycle matching. If its area exceeds 5,852.255041 um2, a matched bypass F2 DC result becomes mandatory before selecting width.

Complete-FC2 admission still requires the accepted window-head, tagged SRAM response and stale quarantine, Acc24/commit and result-backpressure composition; standalone compactor results do not establish these paths.
F4's 384-bit downstream write wiring/ports and activity energy are excluded. The 1.2718 percent additive advantage is narrow enough that those costs can reverse it.
The 0.6 ps hold slack is technically MET only in an ideal-clock pre-macro DC model; retain physical_speedup=false and obtain CTS/post-route hold evidence before any physical claim.
Run RTL-to-gate Formality for whichever bypass width survives; current M201 has SVF and mapped netlist but no admitted equivalence receipt.
